dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #You're here, {NICKNAME}! Finally!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Welcome to stronghold numero two of the Arataki Gang, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh... is that a trick question? This is me we're talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Send me anywhere in the world — anywhere at all — and I guarantee you I'd be able to live there.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I've slept on the streets, down at the dock, deep in the forest... Pretty much everywhere! Of course, comfort-wise, the cells at the Police Station are up there at the top of the list.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That was all before I met you, though.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: This place is something else! In fact, I'm gonna go on the record and say that the comfort level here is like 10... No, what am I saying — 100 prison cells rolled into one!

choices.text: I don't want it to be like any number of prison cells!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Why not? They're great!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anyway, look me in the eyes, and listen up, okay? This place is awesome!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anyway... point made, boom. I'm not gonna drag it out like some... granny at a tea party.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But the code of the streets says I should find a way to express my, uh, you know, gratitude... but, I know... I—I can be your bouncer here!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha! Seriously though, I'm just telling it how it is. I think we're past the point where we need to be polite to each other all the time.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If it's okay with you, I might actually make this my main pad. It's a sweet deal, I'm pretty psyched at the idea of crashing here every night...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have time for a chat?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Argh... where do I start...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's happened?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I've been doing some thinking over the last couple of days about how I keep losing my Onikabuto fights, and, well... I'm starting to think that maybe I should just give it up now.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Maybe it's time to make a clean break, you know? To stop wasting my time on things which just don't matter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean you're...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You bet — I'm giving up Onikabuto fights for good! From this day forward, it's Fireflies all the way, baby!

choices.text: Maybe the issue isn't about the bugs...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Not about the bugs... like how? Are you saying I should go for a boar instead? Or a bird maybe? Nah... too much hard work!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You do you have a point though — swapping out one kind of bug for another won't necessarily improve my odds of winning...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anyway, whatever. At the end of the day, I just haven't found the bug for me. Ugh, seems like you can't go looking for a strong companion, you've gotta wait for the right one to come along...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Luckily for me, you're not like them at all: You and I are like an absolute powerhouse together!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Also, I'm not a bug!!!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha, right, there's that too! I was just kidding, of course. My mind never even went there.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If we ever got into a situation where a fight was unavoidable, naturally I'd be the one to take it for the team.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: All you'd have to do is stand back and root for me. At the top of your voice, you know, really giving it all you've got. When it comes to the atmosphere, you've gotta go big or go home!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha... All we're missing now is a catchy chant...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ummm... Okay, okay, I think I got something: "Arataki Itto, the strongest in his class! Meet him on the street-o, he'll make you kiss his feet-o!"

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Sound good? Haha. Alright, let's practice it together now!

choices.text: Maybe it's to do with the people you're playing with...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The people? Nah! No way. Not possible!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The kids I battle with might talk a whole lot, and sure, there's a few pranksters among them — but they're no cheaters!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! Perfect timing. There's something I need to talk to you about. Something important. Has to be face to face.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So this, uh, Adventurers' Guild — what kind of things do they do? And which tasks do you normally take?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to join the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hah, me? No way!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You gotta be there, what, every other day? They seem to work you pretty hard, so...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I'mma put my boys on the case! Many hands make light work and all that, y'know...

choices.text: Oh right... You want to help me.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait, what do you mean, "oh right"!? C'mon, that's hurtful, where's the enthusiasm?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Next time, I don't wanna hear "oh right, Itto wants to help." I wanna hear "darn right, Itto wants to help"! Got it?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I see you as a member of the Arataki Gang! You do know that, don't you?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Every single member of my gang is like family to me. And, you know... same goes for you.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That makes this a family matter, you get it? Which means, leave it to Itto!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Don't you worry now, I've got your back wherever you go. Whether you're cruising the city or wandering the wilds, my boys will be there!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, except... only in Inazuma. How am I supposed to protect you if you leave?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hah! Guess it's time for the Arataki Gang to start expanding into other nations!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry about me, I can look after myself!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha, that's the spirit! That's what makes you part of my crew.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Guess that settles it then. When I'm not around, promise me you'll carry on being a champ and living life to the max.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: And when I say being a champ — that means kicking some serious butt, alright? I don't care if you're playing card games or you're brawling — no losing! Not to anyone!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem... I was hoping for more of a "sorry, I didn't ask you to help, Itto" than a "thank you"!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I know you've asked other people for help in the past, so why not me, huh? What's that about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}! It really is — seriously, I slept like a baby last night, so I am feeling prett-tay pumped this morning!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So, what're you up to today, huh? Need my help with anything? Whatever it is, just say the word and Itto is on the case!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodnight, Itto.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wait... what? You're hitting the hay already?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Come on, sleep is for the weak! Not champions like you and I! You wanna play some Hide-and-Seek?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Playing at night takes it to a whole other level. Seriously, I'm preparing to go full oni on you here — so make sure you find a good hiding spot, capiche!?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Whoa, check it out, this looks just like Granny Oni's place...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Pretty sweet. The scenery's really makin' my day!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Let's go kick back in the shade. I'll tell you all my epic tales from roaming the wilds of Inazuma!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh boy, you did not disappoint. This festive street is exactly my scene!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: ...Time to get serious, though. Let's pick a stall and go head-to-head, winner takes it all!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: The loser has to, uhh... has to run around the place three times while shouting to the winner, "All Hail, King of the Festival!"
